commands.command: TBD: formalize strict zero-relvel outcome-critical wrong-history repeat gate after M126 rejects hidden-envelope R2 as primary proof
commands.name: m127_outcome_centric_self_id_proof_gate

decision_rule: Admit a proof surface only if strict zero-relvel wrong-history outcome degradation repeats across seeds/checkpoints while M62 and non-history controls remain clean.
failure_criteria: accepted rows disappear on repeat miners
the surface remains perturbed-only without an explicit limitation
no-action or wrong-history intervention remains neutral on all outcome gates
the result is treated as driver success instead of a proof-surface gate
hypothesis: M126 shows hidden-envelope R2 is not a reliable primary gate, but strict outcome-critical wrong-history surfaces remain source-diverse for M124. An outcome-centric formal gate may be the right proof surface for closed-loop self-identification.
success_criteria: M124 strict zero-relvel outcome-critical rows repeat across fresh miner seeds
source diversity remains above the M122/M126 thresholds
the gate reports perturbed/nominal source-side coverage
the next training/proof step is decided from outcome-level evidence
